67:13.text: And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, Verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts

67:14.text: Should not He Who has created know? And He is the Most Kind and Courteous

67:15.text: He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you
(i.e. easy for you to walk, to live and to do agriculture on it)
; so walk in the path thereof and eat of His provision. And to Him will be the Resurrection.

67:16.text: Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven
, will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then it should quake?

67:17.text: Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven
, will not send against you a violent whirlwind? Then you shall know how

67:18.text: And indeed those before them belied
, then how terrible was My denial

67:19.text: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in? None upholds them except the Most Gracious
. Verily, He is the All-Seer of everything.

67:20.text: Who is he besides the Most Gracious that can be an army to you to help you? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.

67:21.text: Who is he that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision? Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and

67:22.text: on his face, more rightly guided, or he who
walks upright on the Straight Way

67:23.text: Say it is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing
, and hearts. Little thanks you give.

67:24.text: Say: "It is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered

67:25.text: come to pass if you are telling the truth.?"

67:26.text: is with Allâh only, and I am only a plain warner."
